observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same white 2-seater couch from slightly different angles.
The couch has visible stains, dirt, and wear on the fabric, especially on the seat cushions and backrest.
The armrests are padded and show some creasing and discoloration.
The couch is placed on a tiled floor against a red wall with a wooden shelf above it.
No brand or model is visible on the couch in either photo.
The seller claims it is 'neatly used' and 'bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm' — these claims are contradicted by the visible stains and wear.

claims.claim: A neatly used 2-seater couch for sale.
claims.evidence: Photos show visible stains, dirt, and wear, contradicting 'neatly used'.

claims.claim: I am selling it because I bought another one
claims.evidence: Seller's reason is stated but not verifiable from photos.

claims.claim: Bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm. From a smoke free home.
claims.evidence: Photos show stains and wear, contradicting 'no stain' and 'no tear'.

risks.risk: The couch may have structural damage or loose parts not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the frame, joints, and underside of the couch.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially unstable or damaged.

risks.risk: The stains and dirt may be deep-set or from prior use, not just surface grime.
risks.proof: A close-up of the stains on the seat cushions and backrest, showing depth and texture.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having hidden stains or odors, reducing value.

risks.risk: The couch may not be in good condition for seating — e.g., broken springs, sagging foam, or missing parts.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the couch being pressed or a close-up of the foam under the seat.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly not fully functional or comfortable.

proof_requests: Close-up of the stains on the seat cushions and backrest to assess depth and type.
Photo or video of the underside and frame to check for damage or loose parts.
Close-up of the foam under the seat to check for sagging or damage.
Photo of the back of the couch to check for tears or wear.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
